Consultancy & Professional Services

Bill for your time, track your costs, and know which projects are profitable — without a separate project management tool.

Your challenges

Time tracking

Your product is time. Without accurate timesheets, you cannot bill clients correctly, measure utilisation, or know which projects are profitable.

Project profitability

You invoice clients, but you do not know the actual margin per project — especially when staff work across multiple projects and expenses are allocated manually.

Resource allocation

Your consultants are spread across projects. Who is over-allocated? Who has capacity? Without visibility, you overcommit some and underutilise others.

Expense management

Travel, printing, and other project expenses are captured on paper or in personal spreadsheets. Reimbursing staff and billing clients requires manual consolidation.

How Kraal Code helps

Project Register

Create projects with clients, budgets, timelines, and responsible managers. Track status from initiation through execution and closure.

Timesheets

Staff record time against projects and tasks. Approve timesheets through workflow. Use approved time for billing and project costing.

Project Billing

Generate invoices from timesheets and milestones. Support fixed-price and time-and-materials models. Track billed vs unbilled amounts.

Resource Allocation

Assign team members to projects with allocation percentages. Track utilisation rates. Identify capacity and over-allocation.

Expense Tracking

Record project expenses. Route through approval workflows. Allocate to projects for costing. Include in client invoices where applicable.

Project Profitability

Revenue minus costs (time + expenses) per project. Margin analysis by client, project type, and period. Know which engagements are profitable.
